INTERPRETATION

What this can tell us

Jev receives the numeric row, the same labeled examples and the source model’s cached class proposal. It may keep or change that proposal. No new rationale is generated.

Compare the pipeline with Jev alone too: rescuing a weak source does not establish that the first stage adds value.
